cards: Khufu was a king of Egypt's Fourth Dynasty in the 26th century BCE and the son of Sneferu.
Sneferu was the founder of Egypt's Fourth Dynasty, reigning in the 26th century BCE.
Ur-Nanshe was the founder of the First Dynasty of Lagash in Sumer around 2500 BCE.
r. c. 2500 BCE · Ancient Near East
Menkaure was a king of Egypt's Fourth Dynasty in the 26th century BCE, probably a son of Khafre.
Meskalamdug was a ruler of Ur around 2600–2500 BCE, known from finds in the Royal Cemetery excavated by Leonard Woolley.
